_authority: L45 (owner, 2026-10-05): the NOVIKONTAS classroom system's own rules for a course folder - from tablet-system-win/COURSE_FACTORY_PROMPT.md ('Give this whole file to the course factory at the start of a new course') and the admin panel's importer, admin/package-core.mjs, of which course-tablet-publisher/vendor/package-core.mjs is a byte-identical copy. Where any older layout rule in this factory differs (L43's module names, the presentation file, the instructor notes file), THIS wins: it is what the classroom reads. scripts/check_course_package.py checks a folder against it and then runs the importer itself.
where: course\modules\ in the work folder (L44) IS the course folder that is added to the classroom: COURSE.html, _course_shell\, module01\ ... moduleNN\. to_review\ and working_claude\ stay beside it and are never uploaded.

layout.COURSE.html: the course start page; its <title> is the course title - and the course ID is made from that title, so the title never changes once the course is added. Optional <meta name="description" content="...">. Instructor-only.
layout._course_shell/course_map.js: window.COURSE_MAP = [{"code":"module01","title":"Gas tankers","entry":"presentation/index.html"}, ...]; - the module order and titles, read as data, never run. The factory always writes it.
layout.moduleNN/: two digits, taught in that order: module01, module02 ... the final assessment is the last one (L34).
layout.moduleNN/presentation/index.html: the instructor's deck (projector). The system finds a module by this file. Instructor-only.
layout.moduleNN/START_HERE.html: instructor-only; opens the presentation straight away (L43).
layout.moduleNN/START_HERE_EXTENDED.html: instructor-only; a button for the presentation, every task, the module check, the plan, the handout (L43).
layout.moduleNN/tasks/<code>_<slug>.html: one page per trainee task (a self-check is one page with all its questions). No tasks/index.html: the trainee never sees a task list (L35).
layout.moduleNN/assessment/check.html: the module check (trainee-facing). The final assessment: assessment/final.html in the last module.
layout.moduleNN/assessment/check_answer_key.htm: answers and marking - instructor-only by its name.
layout.moduleNN/handout/index.html: optional reading the trainee may open at any time.
layout.moduleNN/instructor/: the module plan, practical cards - instructor-only by its folder name.
layout.moduleNN/assets/: every picture, model, film, style, font and script the module uses (L43: the module needs nothing outside its own folder).

names.no_spaces: never a space in a folder or file name - pictures copied from the old course are renamed
names.task_file: <code lower-case>_<title as a slug>.html, e.g. sc1_keeping_the_cargo_liquid.html - and the name never changes in later versions: results are filed under it
names.codes: the code on the slide (data-activity), in the page title and in the result is the same: SC1, SC2 ... for the self-checks of a module, TT1, TT2 ... for team tasks on the tablets, MC for its module check, P1, P2 ... for work in the room, FA for the final assessment
names.task_menu: the rulebook allows an optional tasks/index.html menu; the factory never makes one - the owner's L35: a trainee sees only the task the instructor opens

limits.pictures: JPEG or WebP, 1600 px on the long side is plenty; a file over 15 MB does not import - shorten, compress or split it. A 3D model is compressed without visible loss (gltf-transform: meshopt, KTX2) - never made plainer (L46)
limits._file_bytes: 15 MB since the classroom importer of 2026-10-06 (tablet-system-win 6f44b1f: a short video is ordinary course material; a big file travels in parts). COURSE_FACTORY_PROMPT.md still says 6 MB - the importer is what decides.
limits.offline: no http(s) source, script, style or font; every link relative and inside the course; no Google Fonts - every font has a system fallback

deck.slide: <section class="slide" id="s07" data-title="..." data-kind="Theory" data-day="1" data-block="A1" data-cue="...">
deck.data_cue: the instructor notes of that slide (2.18.1: short points) - the instructor's panel shows them; the projector never does. This, not a .md file, is how the notes reach the panel: the importer skips .md files.
deck.task_slide:
data-kind="Task" data-activity="SC1" data-task-href="../tasks/sc1_keeping_the_cargo_liquid.html" data-title="SC1 — Keeping the cargo liquid", with

SC1

...

- the panel shows ▶ Start and opens exactly that page on every trainee tablet (L35's OPEN TASK)
deck.room_slide: work on paper or in the room: data-kind="Task" data-activity="P1", NO data-task-href, data-link-hint="Work in pairs at the simulator"
deck.data_visual: the factory's own: every .slide carries data-visual="<visual_kind>" from the approved content script (photo, schematic, model_3d ... or none) - the classroom ignores it; check_course_package.py counts the 3D share by it (L46)
deck.navigation: the visible slide has class 'slide active'; ArrowRight / ArrowLeft move, each press shows the next .frag first; F may go fullscreen with document.documentElement.requestFullscreen(); no countdown of the deck's own - the classroom runs the timer and hides .act-timer / .act-note on the projector

task_page.viewport: Android WebView, landscape, about 1280 x 800 CSS px, touch only (L42's numbers apply: 56 px controls, 18 px question text)
task_page.title: <title>SC1 — Keeping the cargo liquid</title> - the code, then the title
task_page.standalone: works on its own - never depends on the deck or another page
task_page.result: show the result on the page, then report it ONCE: window.parent.postMessage({type:'gb-task-done', code:'SC1', title:'Keeping the cargo liquid', ok:7, total:9, head:'', items:[{t:'1. ...', ok:false, a:'what the trainee picked', c:'the right answer', w:'why - the page's own explanation'}, ...], detail:2, answered:8, of:9, timeout:false}, '*') - 2.67.0: each question WHOLE (t <= 90, a and c <= 120, w <= 400 characters), detail:2 says so; a blind final (FA / FB) sends a, c and w empty. The training app re-read the screens when only {t, ok} came, split one question into several and lost the why (gas M07: 4 questions became 11 items)
task_page.head: self-check and module check: '' (no pass mark - owner Raivis, 2026-10-21, the instructors' review: a module check shows its score only, for the trainee and the instructor to know what was understood; it was PASSED / NOT PASSED from 2026-10-05). Final assessment: 'PASSED' or 'NOT PASSED', with the pass mark stated on the page and applied there - the only official test
task_page.timer: the instructor's timer arrives as {type:'gb-timer', endsAt, remaining}; at 0 the page marks what was done and reports it with timeout:true. The page never shows a countdown of its own.
task_page.result_is_last: the classroom rulebook of 2026-10-19: after reporting, the page shows the score and nothing else to press - no 'Answers', 'Review', 'Show solution', 'Next task', 'Menu' or 'Home' button, and no link. The trainee tablet has no back button and no address bar, so any page the trainee goes to is a dead end. The classroom shows the right answers to everyone afterwards (the debrief), built from items. 2.63.2 (Aleksis, 2026-10-22 - TO CONFIRM with Raivis against the training app): on a self-check and a module check the result screen itself lists, under the score, each wrong question's answer (struck) and the right one, an order beside the right order, a misplaced card and its right place - words only on the same scrollable screen, worked out by the engine after the answer, nothing to press; the final assessment stays blind and lists none; the gb-task-done report is unchanged.
task_page.stays_on_its_page: within a task the trainee moves only between the task's own steps (tabs, Next / Previous between questions) on the same page; the frame never goes to another file (no <a href> to a file, no location.href / assign / replace) and nothing opens a new window (target=_blank, window.open)
task_page.no_retry_in_class: after the report, no 'Start again' inside the classroom frame - one opening, one result. Retries only outside it (window.parent === window).
task_page.answers_hidden: never put the answers in a trainee page's source where they can be read without doing the task; marking sheets are separate instructor-only files
task_page.answer_keys: the factory's way (2.23.0): a trainee page never carries data-correct, data-answer or a plain list of right answers. Each answer element carries data-key = gbKey(screen id, its text, value) - the FNV-1a hash below - where value is 1 for right and 0 for wrong (an order task: the 1-based place; sort into groups: the group's name; match: the partner's text; a value on a dial: one key per accepted step, gbKey(id, unit, value with the dial's decimals), listed space-separated in the dial's data-key; operate the panel: the control's name on the position it must end in; a card that is both right or wrong AND has a place - build the plan, rebuild the incident - keeps 1 / 0 in data-key and its place in data-place, the same function, 0 = it stays out). The page grades by working out the key of what the trainee did and comparing; check_script_match.py checks the keys against the approved script. function gbKey(id, text, value) { var s = id + '|' + String(text).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() + '|' + value, b = new TextEncoder().encode(s), h = 0x811c9dc5; for (var i = 0; i < b.length; i++) { h ^= b[i]; h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0; } return ('0000000' + h.toString(16)).slice(-8); }
task_page.team: a team task (section team_task) also reads the team the classroom sends, shows the team name and the trainee's role at the top, and runs as an individual task when no team arrives within about 2 seconds

team_task._authority: the classroom rulebook of 2026-10-12, section 4b (the owner pasted it into the factory session): some practical tasks are done by a team, not one trainee - a cargo plan drawn up by three people, a drill with a leader, a recorder and a checker. The classroom splits a class into Team A, Team B ...; a team task is planned, run and scored per team. Mark it in both places, so the system sorts it into teams without guessing.
team_task.slide: <section class="slide" data-kind="Task" data-activity="TT1" data-task-href="../tasks/tt1_plan_the_loading.html" data-mode="team" data-team-size="3" data-roles="Leader|Recorder|Checker" data-title="TT1 — Plan the loading as a team">
team_task.data_mode: team - without it a task is individual
team_task.data_team_size: the size the task is designed for: 3, or 3-4. The instructor splits the class by it; the system refuses no other size
team_task.data_roles: optional, separated by |; members get them in order, round and round
team_task.page_head: <meta name="task-mode" content="team"> <meta name="task-roles" content="Leader|Recorder|Checker"> <meta name="task-scope" content="team">  (task-scope: team or member)
team_task.gb_team: shortly after the page opens: {type:'gb-team', team:{name:'Team A', colour:'#4fd1c5', members:[...], me:'...', role:'Recorder'}}. Show the team name and the trainee's role at the top. A page may give each role its own part (only the Recorder has Submit). No gb-team within about 2 seconds: the class has no teams - run it as an individual task.
team_task.scope_team: the team hands in one answer: the member who submits (normally the Recorder) sends the usual gb-task-done with scope:'team'; the classroom records it for every member; the others' pages show 'Handed in by Olena for Team A'
team_task.gb_team_done: FACTORY PROPOSAL (2.39.0) - the rulebook says the others' pages show who handed in but names no message for it; the compiled pages listen for {type:'gb-team-done', by:'Olena', team:'Team A'} from the classroom, then show 'Handed in by Olena for Team A', lock and send nothing. Their own hand-in adds team (the team's name) and by (gb-team's me) beside scope:'team'. Any member's tablet may hand in - the first to finish - so a team of any size, with any roles, can finish. To be confirmed with the classroom app before the first team task goes into a class.
team_task.scope_member: every member answers on their own tablet and sends gb-task-done as usual; the classroom shows each person's score and the team's average
rules: the team works in one room and the pages do not sync - design for talking: one tablet hands in (team), or everyone answers and the scores are compared (member)
never require a fixed team size - a team of 2 or 5 must still be able to finish
a role never locks a trainee out: every member reads the whole scenario; roles decide only who does which step and who submits
marking as for individual tasks: items per question, so the debrief shows what the team chose
team_task.codes: TT1, TT2 ... - the factory's code for a team task on the tablets (P1, P2 ... stay work on paper or in the room)
team_task.factory: a team task is planned in the content script (a task slide's "team": size, roles, scope) and approved with the words; a module check and the final assessment are always answered by each trainee alone

instructor_only.trainee_copy: only files in tasks/, handout/, documents/, assets/, assessment/ (and _course_shell/course_bridge.js, gb_tokens.css) reach the trainee tablet - and never one of the instructor-only names
instructor_only.rule: a trainee page (tasks/, assessment/check.html, handout/) never links to an instructor-only file - the link would not open on the tablet; a 'back to the guide' link to START_HERE.html is the commonest mistake

skipped_by_the_importer: folders starting with _ (except _course_shell), test_..., knowledge_base, source_files; files .md .txt .py .zip .tgz .bak ... - so nothing of the factory's own may sit inside course\modules\, and nothing the course needs may be one of these
versions: the course ID is fixed when the course is first added; an update is the same ID and a higher version - 1.0.0 to 1.0.1 for fixes, 1.1.0 for new content. A task page keeps its file name across versions.
before_handover: every module has moduleNN/presentation/index.html and every .slide has data-title
every slide that sends trainees to their tablets has data-task-href pointing at a page that exists
every task page reports one gb-task-done with ok, total and items; checks also report head
no external URL, no CDN script, no file over 15 MB
every team task has data-mode="team" on its slide and task-mode / task-scope metas on its page, and works without teams too
no link into a folder whose name starts with _ (except _course_shell)
no working folders inside the course folder (or they start with _)
no trainee page links to START_HERE.html or any other instructor-only file
no task page has an 'Answers' / 'Review' / 'Menu' button or any link that leaves the page; the result screen has nothing to press
every page works by touch alone at 1280 x 800 landscape - in a browser by a colleague, on the tablet by the owner at the end (L39)
